newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan petchem firms jump on BTR selloff.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan petchem firms jump on BTR selloff.

text.p: Three Taiwan petrochemical firms rose sharply in late Monday trade after British industrial conglomerate BTR Plc sold off its majority stakes in them to raise some US$300 million in a corporate realignment.
Minutes before the close, Taita Chemical jumped by the daily seven percent limit, rising T$2.0 to T$31.
Asia Polymer rose T$1.5 or 2.78 percent to T$55.5 and China General Plastics was also up by the daily limit to T$29.3.
Union Petrochemical and USI Far East, in a notice to Taiwan's stock exchange, identified themselves as the buyers of BTR's stakes in Taita Chemical, Asia Polymer and China General Plastics.
The two buyers paid out T$2.707 billion, or about US$98 million and said the remainder of the US$300 purchase price would be raised through bank loans.
Both purchasing firms were relatively stable in late trade, with Union Petrochemical at T$31.8, up 80 cents, and USI Far East at T$31.4, down 10 cents.
